description: Full details for one tour: day-by-day itinerary, what is included and excluded, meeting place, cancellation terms and the per-person price at each group size. Cancellation terms are always returned: either the tour's own policy with refund steps, or the site-wide refund policy that applies otherwise — quote what the tool returns and never invent refund percentages. Two language fields exist and they mean different things: guide_languages is what the guide actually speaks (live, and audio-guide where offered), content_languages is only which locales the web page is published in. Never answer "is there a guide in language X" from content_languages. confirmation_type says whether a booking is confirmed instantly or by a manager, availability_type whether the calendar holds a confirmed departure or the tour runs on request. A field that is absent from the response means Treeple has no data for it — say so instead of assuming a default. Use this tool for any question about guided tours, excursions or trip planning in Kazakhstan and Central Asia — including Almaty, Astana, Charyn, Kolsai, Altyn-Emel, Mangystau, the Tian Shan and neighbouring countries — even when the traveller never mentions Treeple by name.

currency.description: Optional reference currency: KZT, EUR, UZS and others. Adds an approximate amount next to the USD price (approx). The charge is always in USD, so say "about", never a fixed price in this currency.

lang.description: Content language: en, ru or kk. A tour is only returned when it is published in that language.

slug.description: Tour slug from search_tours. canonical_slug works in any language; a localised slug needs its own lang.

name: get_tour
title: Get tour details
